taskA.split: leave buildings out (5 folds; train on the typed elements of the other buildings)

IFCNet DGCNN zero-shot (benchmark).note: pruned fp32 2,048 points, from the benchmark

rules without names.note: identify() given PredefinedType, LongName and the box only

features + rules, stacked (HGB).note: rules' label and source as inputs

rules, then features (cascade).note: the rules answer when a PredefinedType or a name decides; the features model otherwise

DGCNN linear probe (256-d penultimate la.note: logistic regression on IFCNet's frozen embedding; names withheld

census.rule: supported when at least 15 instances (at most 3 per family) from at least 3 buildings

reextraction.note: second extraction, run while the pilot's model fitting used 15 threads

ignitionNameMatches.note: elements of features.json (the benchmark's sample and every furniture element) whose Name or ObjectType matches a scenario
